remarks: A complete 'WOW' in the desirable walk-to-town River Ridge community. Spectacular views, and so many high-level upgrades to this unit (no expense was spared) including: craftsman's millwork/coffered ceilings, inlaid floors, rebuilt floor-to-ceiling fireplace, butler's pantry with marble countertops, custom kitchen with Thermador, Wolf, Sub-zero appliances and specialty-coated Carrera marble countertops, designer lower level entertaining kitchen and family room, radiant heat in Primary Bath, mirrored home gym, heated garage, rebuilt bluestone patio with awning and new stone retaining/sitting wall, generator, Sonos system and more. Celebrity designer's touches everywhere in the fabrics, lighting, millwork and overall aesthetic. This one is over-the-top gorgeous, pristine and exceptional. A dream lifestyle. Don't wait to see it!
